evidence.source: https://github.com/cmroche/gree-research/blob/main/firmware-capabilities/research/PR148/wb-standalone-decompilation/manifest.json; Realtek-1/n01/decompiled.c:855-867 and source-facts.json entry1; complete new-image exports contain real authenticated LAN functions omitted by the older reviewed selection.
evidence.wire: Discovery is ECB/PKCS7 with inner cid=mac; UDP pack ingress forces mode2 and uses GCM with a separate generic key, fixed nonce/AAD and 16-byte authentication tag. Bindok is lowercase. Status omits unknown names and preserves ordered duplicates. Response outer selector/uid and client route are echoed, not forced to device-key slot.
evidence.model: Mainboard-supplied bc/ver/vender/ModelType use literal synthetic values. Atomic controls, model ranges, immediate readback, linear room step and TemSen=floor(Celsius)+40 are simulation choices; native firmware transports UART byte+0x2e unchanged and supplies no same-mainboard calibration. No physical hardware, full boot or captured key is represented.
